resources.string: The row read failed. Check the specific diagnostic notice before changing credentials or retrying.

Requesting Convex row tables over HTTP.

A Convex read token is stored securely.
No Convex read token is stored. Row reads are unconfigured.

Every contribution buys Bitcoin at the same recorded price
401(k), WAP, VOO, IBIT, employer match, taxes, fees, and inflation are excluded because Android has no canonical retirement-account rows
This is arithmetic over the listed inputs, not financial advice or a prediction. Change in price, income, spending, contributions, or returns changes the result.
A projection requires the canonical Bitcoin quantity for this profile. No zero balance was assumed.
The canonical fiat field is not a price source. Add a dated recorded-buy price before converting surplus or bonuses; the app will not project from $0.00.
A projection requires a profile-scoped income month. No zero income was assumed.
A projection requires this profile’s planned monthly spending. No zero budget was assumed.
